name: Exact Ramsey number R(5,5)
question: Which integer from 43 to 46 is the exact value of R(5,5)?
first_attack: Verify published K42 witness; pursue independently checked K43 coloring or K45 UNSAT proof certificate
method_title: A colouring with a proof trace
dispatch_next: Import and check the published K42 witness; reproduce a small structural exclusion with a trusted proof checker.
dispatch_why: The lab certifies R(5,5) greater than 37. The published K42 colouring is the next certificate, and an upper bound needs a proof trace rather than a solver verdict.

campaign.hypothesis: The exact value of R(5,5) can be determined by an independently checked construction and exclusion.
campaign.first_proof_obligation: Verify a candidate K43 two-coloring or independently certify the nonexistence of a K45 valid coloring.
campaign.next_experiment: Import and check the published K42 witness; reproduce a small structural exclusion with a trusted proof checker.
campaign.falsification: A verified K43 coloring would refute any claimed R(5,5)<=43; a valid K45 coloring would refute R(5,5)<=45.
campaign.blocker: A SAT solver UNSAT output without a verified proof trace does not establish an upper bound.

probes.name: Exact Ramsey number R(5,5)
probes.title: Exact Ramsey lower-bound colourings (Paley and circulant graphs)
probes.frontier: Known: R(3,3)=6, R(3,4)=9, R(3,5)=14, R(4,4)=18; 43 <= R(5,5) <= 46 (lower bound Exoo 1989). Witnesses here reproduce classical lower bounds.

smoke.scope: Explicit colourings certify R(3,3) > 5, R(3,4) > 8, R(3,5) > 13, R(4,4) > 17.

deep.scope: Explicit colourings certify R(3,3) > 5, R(3,4) > 8, R(3,5) > 13, R(4,4) > 17, R(5,5) > 37.

milestones.title: Ramsey R(3,3)=6 reproduced
milestones.scope: Finite toy theorem; not a new bound on R(5,5)
milestones.description: C5 witnesses R(3,3)>5; all 32,768 labeled K6 two-colorings fail to avoid both triangles.

milestones.title: Ramsey lower bounds R(3,4) > 8, R(3,5) > 13, R(4,4) > 17 certified
milestones.scope: Classical lower bounds; not a new bound on R(5,5)
milestones.description: Circulant and Paley colourings checked by exhaustive subset enumeration; the deep run adds Paley(37), certifying R(5,5) > 37 (the best known lower bound is 43).

formal_statement.encodes: Arrows n s t: every red/blue colouring of K_n has a red K_s or a blue K_t (cliques as vertex bitmasks). Conjecture: Arrows 43 5 5.
not_encoded: The known bounds ¬Arrows 42 5 5 and Arrows 46 5 5 are cited, not re-proved

kernel_checked.claim: R(3,3) > 5: the pentagon colouring has no monochromatic triangle.

discovery_trail.question: What separates a certified Ramsey lower bound from a new exact value of R(5,5)?

nodes.title: Start from the published interval 43–46
nodes.detail: The audited published bound is 43 ≤ R(5,5) ≤ 46; neither endpoint equality nor a 43-vertex avoiding coloring is established here.

nodes.title: Check 328 published 42-vertex colorings
nodes.detail: A SHA-256-pinned McKay catalog is checked using two different K5 search methods, reproducing R(5,5) ≥ 43. Complements give color-swapped examples, not a completeness argument.

nodes.title: Require a new witness or checked exclusion
nodes.detail: Improving the lower bound needs a K43 coloring with no monochromatic K5; improving the upper bound needs an exhaustive argument with independently checked proof traces. A solver verdict alone is insufficient.
